title: Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/x)
desc:
About Us
With over 2.400 employees, Fichtner is Germany’s leading independent planning and consultancy enterprise. We are global players and tackle challenging projects in more than 100 countries. Among our clients are companies from the sectors of central utility supplies and waste management, international development and commercial banks, investors, public administrations, and energy-intensive industrial enterprises. We offer our clients a unique combination of engineering consultancy with classical management consultancy. To maintain our sustainable growth process, we are looking to fill a permanent position as
Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/x)
Your Tasks
Preparation of due diligence and feasibility reports
Preparation of technical studies and evaluation reports
Join technical clarification meetings and contract negotiations with clients and contractors
Preparation of specifications for electrical systems of tenders
Power Plant Design works: including preparation of single line diagrams, layouts, drawings
Analyze (and potentially prepare) power system studies (load flow, short circuit, stability studies, dynamic simulations)
Review of contractors’ design documents
Support site erection and commissioning activities
Perform site visits to observe project progress or evaluate the conditions of assets
Monitor operational parameters of power plants or power grids
Liaise with other technical specialists including specialists from Fichtner offices worldwide
Your Profile
University degree in Electrical Engineering, preferably with focus on power plants or energy transmission/distribution
At least eight (8+) years’ experience in the design or development of power plant or substation projects, preferably including experience in both renewable and conventional energy sector;
Excellent understanding of main power plant equipment;
Ability to perform as part of a team technical due diligence studies, feasibility studies and specifications of power plant and / or transmission projects
First experience with project management tasks would be an asset
Strong communication skills
Fluent knowledge of English and Turkish; German or Arabic knowledge would be an asset
Having an analytical mindset and being open to development
Ability to work with tight deadlines and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Flexibility and willingness to travel (within Turkey and abroad)
Driving License: B (for Turkey)
Corporate Benefits
Permanent work contract in our Istanbul office
Comprehensive fringe benefits (Transport Support, Private Health Insurance, Lunch Bonus)
We provide an environment that unites enduring value with innovative capability
Wide degree of latitude, hybrid working and the ability to work under your own responsibility
State of the art engineering projects
